items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: He used to take the certain type of wood that they would use to make the Freddie Green with Connelly and all of them.

ctx.x: Liotta Lyon was down there, or recorded with Al Hood when he was on this, what you call him here, Liotta Lyon. He, when you were going all over like I was, it was nice to meet everybody. You see, those bands like Jimmy Noon and all of them, they were coming down in northern part of Louisiana before they started coming here. You understand? You see all them bands used to come down there. See because everybody would turn out, you know it's like the Saints football game, everybody would turn out with all those…
You did play with Cheik because Henry Russ told me about that.
